aspects.label: Decision (the sharp DEWY-D question and its bearing)

spec_rule.L0: Receipt.decision empty (cannot occur: column is required and the route clamps the user question into it)
spec_rule.L1: Receipt.decision present but only the raw user text (no coherencePct, no clarity lens): the sharpening is inferred
spec_rule.L2: Receipt.decision present and Receipt.coherencePct non-null (the model stated how well-formed the question is)
spec_rule.L3: Receipt.sharpQuestion or Receipt.dewyVector.D non-null (the question decomposed into the schema-canonical atomic form)
spec_rule.L4: Brief.situationFraming exists for this receiptId and restates the same decision (second model call, brief route, semi-independent of the compass call)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.what exists for this receiptId and names the same decision

spec_rule.L1: trueNorth present, whyBullets parses to an empty array
spec_rule.L2: trueNorth present and whyBullets has at least one bullet
spec_rule.L3: whyBullets has 2 or more bullets AND nciSelfGrade.action is true (the bearing decomposed into reasons and self-graded as one concrete step)
spec_rule.L4: rawResponse.reasoning.paths contains a path with status 'selected' whose tag is 'True North' and whose title agrees with trueNorth (the paths block is a separate section of the same response: weakly independent, say so when scoring)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.matched is true for this receiptId

spec_rule.L1: atgTributaries parses but has fewer than 3 entries or entries lack a type
spec_rule.L2: atgTributaries has exactly 3 entries with prompts
spec_rule.L3: the 3 entries carry the typed triple meta / challenge / adjacent with non-empty prompts
spec_rule.L4: a child Receipt exists whose parentId is this receipt AND whose parentTributaryIndex is 0, 1 or 2 (the follow-up actually taken confirms the tributary)
spec_rule.L5: not applicable: no Outcome field bears on which tributary was taken; stays L4 max

cells.label: Mode and door (QUICKMOVE / PLAN / COURT, ONE_WAY / TWO_WAY)

spec_rule.L1: mode present but doorClass null
spec_rule.L2: mode and doorClass both present (both are derived by rule in route.ts selectMode and doorClass from horizon plus stakes)
spec_rule.L3: rawResponse.reasoning.geometry.mode_trigger non-empty (the trigger named, e.g. 'HIGH stakes + ONE_WAY door')
spec_rule.L4: rawResponse.decision_mode equals Receipt.mode AND rawResponse.door_class equals Receipt.doorClass (the model's own read agrees with the rule-derived stored value: genuinely independent sources)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome row exists and regretScore <= 2 on a ONE_WAY receipt, or any Outcome on TWO_WAY (the door held)

spec_rule.L1: seed receipt: parentId null, version 0 (the thread is inferred to start here)
spec_rule.L2: child receipt: parentId non-null and version >= 1 (the thread position is stated)
spec_rule.L3: forkPath non-null or parentTributaryIndex non-null (which branch was taken is decomposed)
spec_rule.L4: batonId non-null or mergedFrom non-empty (a second receipt independently points back at this one)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome row exists on this receipt or on its batonId successor

aspects.label: Risk / Ruin (gauntlet family: BAR, LAB, COURT, KKL, Funhouse)

spec_rule.L1: Receipt.stakes present but came from the request body with no PrepSession (route: activeStakes = prep?.stakes ?? stakes); includes the 2 lowercase variants, which must be upper-cased at read time
spec_rule.L2: Receipt.stakes present and normalized to LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH (schema also allows EXISTENTIAL; 0 observed)
spec_rule.L3: Receipt.protecting parses to a non-empty array (the stake decomposed into what is being protected: cash, time, reputation)
spec_rule.L4: a PrepSession row is linked (Receipt.prepId) and PrepSession.stakes equals Receipt.stakes (user-calibrated value agrees with the stored value)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.regretScore exists for this receipt (the stake was settled)

spec_rule.L1: courtVerdict present but court array empty (a ruling with no named checks)
spec_rule.L2: court array has at least 1 check with a verdict in PASS / TENSION / BLOCK
spec_rule.L3: court has 2 or more checks with verdicts AND courtVerdict is non-empty (the ruling decomposed into named checks)
spec_rule.L4: Brief.entityAnalysis.risk_surface or a Tribune row for this receipt names the same blocking or tension condition (brief route and Tribune are separate writes)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.learning exists and the court's BLOCK or TENSION check is referenced

cells.label: Threat vectors (LAB: Loki objection, counter, Bayesian risk)

spec_rule.L1: only consensus or bayesian_risk_pct present (risk inferred, no named objection)
spec_rule.L2: loki_challenge non-empty (the strongest objection stated)
spec_rule.L3: loki_challenge AND loki_counter AND bayesian_risk_pct all present (objection, rebuttal, and a number)
spec_rule.L4: PrepSession.adversarialInput is non-empty and overlaps loki_challenge (the user's own strongest case against their instinct agrees with the model's)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.matched is false and Outcome.learning names the Loki objection (the threat landed), or matched true with learning stating the objection did not materialize

spec_rule.L1: doorClass only (reversibility inferred from the horizon plus stakes rule)
spec_rule.L2: geometry.reversibility parses to a leading float in [0.05, 1.0] (parse: regex ^\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) on the string; the label after the first dash is kept as text)
spec_rule.L3: Receipt.fated.tradeoffs or fated.direction names the ruin case, or Receipt.bar JSON {ruin_risk, asymmetry, reversibility} is present (bar: 0 by code path today)
spec_rule.L4: doorClass agrees with the parsed float: ONE_WAY when float >= 0.5, TWO_WAY when float < 0.5 (~ threshold assessed from the single contract sample '0.7 - High (one-way)'; the rule-derived doorClass and the model's float are independent). Also counts: yConditions contains dim 9 RED and doorClass is ONE_WAY
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.regretScore exists; regretScore >= 4 on a ONE_WAY receipt is a confirmed ruin-edge event

cells.label: Failure modes and de-risks (KKL / Funhouse: drags, blocked paths)

spec_rule.L0: nci_breakdown absent and no blocked path
spec_rule.L1: macroTags includes KKL or BAR with no drag listed (the failure class is inferred from the tag only)
spec_rule.L2: nci_breakdown.drags has at least 1 entry with label and delta
spec_rule.L3: drags carry pct AND at least one path has status 'blocked' with detail (failure modes decomposed into weighted drags and a closed path)
spec_rule.L4: Brief.entityAnalysis.signal_to_watch or a Tribune row names the same drag
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.learning exists and names a drag

aspects.label: Window (heading, bearing, bounded entry window, safe-vs-dangerous conditions)

spec_rule.L0: horizon null and window empty (cannot occur: window required)
spec_rule.L1: horizon came from the request body with no PrepSession (route: activeHorizon = prep?.horizon ?? horizon); the window is the user's quick pick, not calibrated
spec_rule.L2: Receipt.horizon normalized to TODAY / WEEK / QUARTER / YEARS via src/lib/horizon.ts normalizeHorizon
spec_rule.L3: reviewDate and reminderDate both set (the window decomposed into a check date and a resolve-by date; the route writes both on every receipt)
spec_rule.L4: PrepSession.horizon equals Receipt.window (user-calibrated window agrees), or horizonLocked is true
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.loggedAt falls on or before reviewDate (the window held)

spec_rule.L0: geometry.kairos absent or first token is N/A
spec_rule.L1: kairos present but the first token is not in the known set (free text; the state is inferred from the clause)
spec_rule.L2: first token parses to one of OPEN, CLOSED, CLOSING, CONDITIONAL, URGENT, ACUTE, LATENT, FORCED, DEFERRED, CRITICAL, UNCERTAIN (parse: upper-case the string, take the leading run of letters and slashes before the first space or dash, strip punctuation)
spec_rule.L3: L2 plus a trailing clause after the dash (e.g. 'act this week') AND Receipt.nciByLens.cadence non-null (timing decomposed into state, instruction, and a lens score)
spec_rule.L4: token agrees with Receipt.horizon: URGENT / ACUTE / CRITICAL / FORCED with TODAY or WEEK; OPEN / CONDITIONAL / CLOSING with WEEK or QUARTER; LATENT / DEFERRED with QUARTER or YEARS (~ band mapping assessed, not in code)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.loggedAt exists and the outcome landed inside the reminderDate window

cells.label: Entry conditions (Y gate: safe vs dangerous to proceed)

spec_rule.L1: yState present with yConditions '[]' (the state fell out of the nci thresholds alone: GREEN or YELLOW by nci band)
spec_rule.L2: yConditions has at least 1 {dim, label, severity} entry (a named condition fired)
spec_rule.L3: yGateScore JSON carries polarity, conviction, stability, render_resolution and visual_treatment, and yConditions has 2 or more entries
spec_rule.L4: PrepSession.confidence agrees with yConviction (1 or 2 with LOW, 3 with MEDIUM, 4 or 5 with HIGH; user-supplied, independent of the gate), or yOverride is true with yOverrideNote (the human read the gate and ruled)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.matched exists; matched true on a GREEN or FORK receipt, or matched false on a RED-condition receipt, confirms the gate

spec_rule.L1: paths has 1 entry (no fork; the heading is inferred to be the only line)
spec_rule.L2: paths has 2 or more entries with id and title
spec_rule.L3: every path carries a status in selected / blocked / viable and a detail (the fork decomposed into open and closed lines)
spec_rule.L4: forkPath is set on this receipt, or a child receipt's decision text names one of this receipt's path titles (the skintrack actually taken agrees with a listed path)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.what names a listed path

cells.label: Drift and trajectory (orientation over the session)

spec_rule.L1: driftState ON_TRACK on a seed (version 0): the default, nothing observed yet
spec_rule.L2: version >= 1 (a trajectory exists: at least two points in the session)
spec_rule.L3: yConvictionPrev and yDeltaTrigger set (the conviction move between parent and child is named)
spec_rule.L4: driftState DRIFTING with version >= 5 (ygate rule) AND the session's receipt count from the DB agrees (sessionVersion is counted from stored rows, a separate read from the parent row), or driftState LANDED with status LOGGED
spec_rule.L5: Outcome row exists and driftState is LANDED (the outcome handler flips LANDED or DRIFTING from Outcome.matched)

aspects.label: Clarity cluster (code wins: clarity, conviction, coherence, consequence, cadence)

cells.label: Clarity (is the question well-formed and atomic)

spec_rule.L1: nciScore only: clarity inferred from the composite (240 receipts)
spec_rule.L2: nciByLens.clarity non-null (0 to 20)
spec_rule.L3: L2 plus nciGrade names the weak lens AND nci_breakdown.drags / anchors present (the score decomposed into named pulls)
spec_rule.L4: coherencePct agrees with the lens: |clarity * 5 - coherencePct| <= 15 (~ tolerance assessed; coherencePct is a separate field in the same response, weakly independent)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.matched exists on this receipt

cells.label: Conviction (how strong and directional the signal is)

spec_rule.L1: yConviction only (ygate derives it from nci bands and fired conditions: inferred)
spec_rule.L2: nciByLens.conviction non-null
spec_rule.L3: L2 plus yConvictionPrev set (conviction decomposed into current and prior)
spec_rule.L4: PrepSession.confidence agrees with yConviction (1 or 2 LOW, 3 MEDIUM, 4 or 5 HIGH); user-supplied, independent of the model
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.matched is true (conviction confirmed by the world)

spec_rule.L1: nciScore only (composite, avg 57.5, p10 38, p90 78)
spec_rule.L2: nciByLens.coherence non-null
spec_rule.L3: L2 plus nci_breakdown.anchors present with pct (coherence decomposed into named anchors)
spec_rule.L4: coherencePct agrees with the lens (|coherence * 5 - coherencePct| <= 15, ~ tolerance assessed)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.matched exists

spec_rule.L1: fated.tradeoffs non-empty (consequence inferred from prose)
spec_rule.L2: nciByLens.consequence non-null
spec_rule.L3: all five fated fields non-empty (facts, assumptions, tradeoffs, emotions, direction)
spec_rule.L4: Brief.entityAnalysis.risk_surface names the same downstream effect (brief route, separate call)
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.regretScore exists (the consequence was felt and scored)

spec_rule.L1: kairos first token parses (timing inferred from the geometry string)
spec_rule.L2: nciByLens.cadence non-null
spec_rule.L3: L2 plus kairos token plus reminderDate (timing decomposed into state, lens, and date)
spec_rule.L4: kairos token agrees with Receipt.horizon per the W2 band mapping
spec_rule.L5: Outcome.loggedAt within the reviewDate window

decisions.title: Large documents (a real RFP runs 400-600 pages)

fields.Decision: Keep retrieval-then-select: the parser chunks the RFP into clauses; each question sends only the question plus ~8 retrieved clauses to the model. The model's context window is never the constraint.
fields.Why: Sam Ito: only what is needed leaves RET's environment. Nina: figures verbatim; checking ~8 clauses is tractable, checking a whole document per answer is not. Measured cost ~$0.0038/question with this path on 2026-10-10 (since re-measured; the deck shows the current figure) (UNIT-ECONOMICS.md); sending the whole document is an estimated ~157x more.
fields.What Changes At 600 Pages, In Order Of R: 1. PDF extraction (tables, page breaks; KINTSUGI K1). Production path: Docling (MIT, runs locally). 2. Retrieval recall (vocabulary misses grow with size; K5, K25). Production path: add local embeddings as a second retriever and merge results; keep the glossary. 3. Bulk extraction of key facts from a new RFP: run offline through a batch API at reduced cost.
fields.Rejected: Whole-document prompts as the answer path (cost, data leaving the environment, unverifiable volume). A long-context model is kept as an optional offline auditor that asks "what did retrieval miss?". Prompt caching: the repeated prefix (instructions) is below the size where it pays.
fields.Revisit When: The PJM real-document test runs (HYPOTHESES H3, H4).

decisions.title: A refusal with no clauses gets a code floor, not a looser gate

fields.Decision: When the model refuses and names no clause, ask once more; if it still names none, cite the retrieved clause that covers the most question words, labelled "related text, does not answer".
fields.Why: Measured (B): the follow-up call alone passed 3 of 3 manual runs, then failed inside the pre-commit gate, so a second model call is still a coin flip. The code floor is deterministic: seam test `test_K33_bare_refusal_still_shows_related_text` forces the worst case (model refuses bare on both calls) and all six refusal cases pass.
fields.Rejected: Gate on 2 of 3 runs, disclosed. It hides the flake instead of removing it, and triples eval spend on every commit. Rejected also: a stronger prompt rule; K27 measured that a prompt change for this case regressed wave 1 from 18/18 to 15/18.
fields.Revisit When: The floor cites a wrong clause in any eval or live question (it is labelled, so a person sees it).

decisions.title: Reusable harness, disposable client surface (Zach, 2026-10-10)

fields.Decision: The build has two layers, kept apart on purpose.
